title: Write a report from JSON data
prompt: data/orders.json has a list of orders. Write report.js so that `node report.js` creates report.md: a heading "# Orders by customer", then a markdown table with columns Customer, Orders and Total, one row per customer sorted by total (highest first), totals formatted like $1,234.50, then a final row "**All**" with the overall counts. Cancelled orders (status "cancelled") are left out. Then run it to create report.md.
